title: TypeSomething header (v2)
description: A frosted white pill that sticks to the top: a bold-and-lime wordmark that types itself out on a loop, centred nav pills with the current page in acid lime, a locale label and a lime CTA. As the page starts to scroll the pill narrows and slims down (scrubbed with the scroll). On phones: wordmark and a round lime menu button that opens the links below the bar.
notes: sticky: put it at the top level of the page so it sticks for the whole scroll
the shrink is a CSS scroll timeline on the nearest scroller; browsers without it keep the resting size
the phone menu is a <details> element, so it opens without JavaScript
name: typesomething-v2-header
